hints: [H+] flows outward from the Sun. A building that pulls resources outward can capture it for you.
Extractors draw resources from the ring below and push them outward. Place one on the outer ring to feed [H+] to a waiting ship.
Build a building on the ring. Click on it and make it an Extractor, choose [H+] as the extracted resource.
[Hi+] is made from [H+] and [St-]. [Ir-] arrives on the outer rings and flows inward, look for the building type that pulls resources in that direction.
Use Inserters to bring [Ir-] inward. Build a [St-] factory ([Ir-]→[St-]), then a [Hi+] factory ([H+]+[St-]→[Hi+]) where outward-flowing [H+] and inward-flowing [St-] can both reach it.

Inject Ir-] on the outer ring, then place Inserters on the ring below to pull it inward. Build a [St-] factory where [Ir-] flows past. Build a [Hi+] factory where both [H+] (carried outward by Extractors from Sol) and [St-] (carried inward by Inserters) converge on adjacent rings.
Bg needs Tritanium, which is made from Cobalt that is transformed at the Sun. Some resources change when they reach Sol's inner lanes.
Build a Cf factory (Ir+Cu). Cf flows inward to Sol and transmutes to T, which flows back outward. Catch it with a Bg factory (H+T).

Inject Ir and Cu on outer rings, carry them inward via Inserters to a Cf factory. Cf reaches Sol's transmutation lanes — click the Sun to see them. The resulting T flows outward, where a Bg factory (H+T) can finish the job.
Mt needs three ingredients flowing from different directions: Copper, Steel, and Tritanium. Plan your factory layout so they converge.
Build St from Ir, Cf from Ir+Cu, and transmute Cf at Sol for T. Position a Mt factory where Cu, St, and T all have lanes passing within range.

Route Ir and Cu inward via Inserters. Build St on a middle ring. Build Cf further out so its product flows to Sol and returns as T. Place the Mt factory where Cu (injected), St (flowing inward), and T (flowing outward from Sol) can all be seen from two rings above it.
XC is the final step in a long chain. Follow each recipe backward: XC needs XB and Cu, XB needs XA, XA needs Hi and Cf.
Build the Steel/Hydrogen chain (Ir→St→Hi) and the Cobalt chain (Ir+Cu→Cf). Then chain XA (Hi+Cf) → XB (XA) → XC (XB+Cu). Each factory feeds the next in sequence.

With 8 rings you have room to spread out. From outer to inner: inject Ir and Cu → St and Cf factories → Hi factory → XA → XB → XC. Use Inserters and Extractors to move each product to the next ring where the receiving factory sits.
SW has three inputs: Ir, CG, and G. Glass comes from Silicon, and Cognitium comes from Borg and Copper.
Build three parallel branches: Si→G (flows outward), the Cf→T→Bg→CG chain, and route Ir inward. Merge all three at a SW factory.

Inject Si on an outer ring with a G factory. Build the transmutation chain: Cf (Ir+Cu) → Sol → T → Bg (H+T) → CG (Bg+Cu). Route Ir inward through separate Inserters. Place SW where the inward Ir stream, outward G stream, and inward CG stream cross paths on nearby rings.

XD needs XC, CG, and G. Each comes from a different production line using the four fast injectors available.
From injected XA: chain XA→XB→XC (+Cu). From injected T and Sol's H: chain T→Bg→CG (+Cu). From injected Si: make G. Merge all three at an XD factory.

With 4 lanes and 30/s injectors, build three branches: XA→XB→XC near your Cu injection, Si→G on an outer ring, and T→Bg→CG using Extractors to bring H from Sol. Place XD where outward-flowing XC, CG, and G can all reach it, and ship from the outermost ring.
Both [D+] and [T+] are transmuted by Sol. You must extract both while also jettisoning [Vt-] and [Cf-] into Sol.
Focus first on transmuting [T+], you will need this to produce [Mt+], and you will then need both [Mt+] and [T+] to produce [Vt-] on Ring 3.
You need all of [Cf-], [Vt-], [T+] and [D+] on Ring 2, and the [Mt+] factories must be on Ring 4.
